init_sawyer_arm: create a SawyerArm instance with configs and an optional moveit planner name
go_home_sawyer: command the Sawyer robot arm to move to its home zero position
move_to_neutral_sawyer: move the Sawyer robot arm to its predefined neutral pose configuration
get_collision_state_sawyer: get the current collision detection state of the Sawyer robot arm
pub_joint_positions_sawyer: publish joint position commands to the Sawyer robot arm via ROS
